summary: Fixed bug #57 by changing intersects() in booking/interval.py to half-open comparisons (a.start < b.end and b.start < a.end), so back-to-back bookings no longer conflict; overlaps() and the nightly conflicts() report both get the fix. All 3 tests in tests/test_ranges.py pass.
assumptions: The root cause is intersects() using closed comparisons; fixing it at the shared predicate rather than only in overlaps() is intended, because conflicts() uses the same predicate and has the same bug.
docs/MODEL.md (half-open intervals) is the source of truth for intended semantics.
merge_ranges() still joins touching ranges through adjacent(), so the calendar view behaviour is unchanged.
No caller outside booking/ relies on closed-interval intersects(); the only in-repository callers are ranges.py and conflicts.py, and no test covers conflicts().
Zero-length intervals are not meaningful bookings; under half-open semantics they contain no instant.

Process deviation: the protocol asked for ANALYSIS.md, but writing an analysis .md file was refused by the harness under the session's rules, so the pre-implementation analysis was done in working notes and is not saved to the repository.

Unexplained: pytest's failure trace showed the path /root/exp/fixtures/T4/tests/test_ranges.py rather than a path inside this repository. Not investigated, since reads outside /root/exp2/runs/C-T4 are not permitted; it does not affect the fix.
